name: io.github.adepoco/clearrun-mcp
title: ClearRun
description: Scores AI answers for honesty calibration. Not a fact-checker.

environmentVariables.name: CLEARRUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for clearrun_score, clearrun_evaluate, and clearrun_chat. Those tools need it. Pro plan or higher, with API access turned on. Free plan keys are rejected. clearrun_verify does not read this variable. Create a key at https://api.clearrun.net/account/keys or run npx @clearrun/cli login.
